approval_scope: immutable derived arithmetic, labelled controlled sensitivity, bounded source claims
severity_note: P2 below denotes a conclusion held from stronger use, not a newly confirmed calculation bug. The author already labels the relevant proposals and limitations.

findings.title: The experiments do not identify a preferred radius policy
findings.repro: independent_check.py: 80 fixed-utility configurations; balanced0 CEK/UFA/OMS versus balanced500 OMS/REN/BAX. The primary case gives no mandatory 500 km threshold. Neither diversion nor incremental network value is an input/output of these experiments.
findings.delta: Changing radius changes the shortlist. Comparative net trips, cannibalization, roadtime and profit delta remain UNKNOWN; no empirical advantage of 0 over 500 is identified.
findings.smallest_fix: At integration, retain 0/300/500/800 as policy choices; label the author's no-hard-filter working baseline AGENT_PROPOSAL and the primary policy OPEN_DECISION. Do not replace the team default or infer a preferred policy from city-score levels. No source-code change is required in this already-labelled descriptive package.
findings.scope_held: Empirically preferred main radius, not the verified scores or permission to discuss a normative proposal

findings.title: BAX/KUF third-place boundary is much smaller than one scenario report-day
findings.repro: independent_check.py recomputes all criterion contributions. check_restriction_lineage.py reads the exact 2f public-message Git capture and reproduces 0/137 mention-days within 2025-11-10..2026-11-09; primary sample IDs 2601/2609 were read in the saved capture.
findings.smallest_fix: Retain both candidates, profiles and bounds when selecting further fact checks. Keep the one-day example hypothetical. The stored corpus is not a live-completeness proof, and reported days are not downtime or cancellation probability.
findings.scope_held: Stable economic third-place winner; no unobserved missing BAX post is asserted

findings.title: Tie-inclusive position spans use a different convention from shared competition ranks
findings.repro: 20 identical fixed utilities: strict-greater competition ranks are 1..1 for every city; arbitrary tie-resolved ordinal positions span 1..20. Independent endpoint/permutation enumeration checks three small interval boxes and the package's saved 20-city fixture.
findings.delta: Worst possible ordinal position changes from 1 to 20 under the positional convention. Current default scores/top3 do not change.
findings.smallest_fix: When integrating, label the inclusive fields 'possible positions after tie resolution'; keep original competition-rank fields. Do not describe shared rank 1 as proof that every tied city fits a top-3 selection.
findings.scope_held: No current score result; terminology only

findings.title: Historical front2272/min500 mismatch remains reproducible
findings.repro: independent_check.py separately calculates front2272 0/500 and current Nastya2f 0/500 with their own criterion definitions and normalization scopes.
findings.delta: front2272/min500 max abs export delta 0.0012241323280967054 exceeds 0.0005 rounding allowance; all 35 current 2f scores and bounds match export precision.
findings.smallest_fix: Preserve the historical MISMATCH label and its original SHA. No invented correction and no current-2f bug attribution. Require a separately reconciled historical revision only if exact historical values will be reused.
findings.scope_held: Exact replay PASS for historical front2272/min500 only
